review: One coin wonder that inflicts buffs and debuffs, with her high speed these buffs will never land on her, althought like every single coin skills rolling tails is pretty much a death sentence for her. She has a spot in early Mirror Dungeon teams and sinking team. Both her field passive and support passive are just generally good and easy to proc. No notable E.G.O. Synergies
